grade_descriptions.Grade A: Like New - Clothing appears almost new, with little to no visible sign of use.
grade_descriptions.Grade B: Very Good - Clothing shows minor visible signs of use but remains in very good condition.
grade_descriptions.Grade C: Good / Usable - Clothing shows visible signs of use or minor defects but remains fully usable.
grade_descriptions.Grade D: Significant Wear - Clothing shows noticeable visible defects or substantial signs of wear.
